scope: Finite-length locality approximation using 1004 and 1604 um tracks at common effective 20 um mesh. This is not equivalent to the published approximately 8 mm track. No fitted parameters, coarse fallback, or experimental validation.

absorptivity.basis: Explicit nominal model assumption, not measured NIST absorptivity; not fitted.

sourcePenetration_um.basis: Explicit nominal volumetric deposition assumption, not an optical or measured NIST penetration depth; not fitted.

preheat_C.basis: Application nominal default, explicit model assumption. Table 5 does not state preheat/ambient temperature. Table 6 pad 22 C is not applied to Table 5.

assumptions.beamMapping: Published 2D Gaussian regression diameter 72 um is mapped to ideal Gaussian 1/e2 diameter; actual measured profile is unavailable.
assumptions.plateAndBoundaries: Model depth about 320 um vs published plate 3170 um; fixed preheat base and insulated sides. Full plate/support geometry is not represented.
assumptions.operator: Single nearest-midpoint accepted-max liquidus thermal contour vs six etched/solidified SAM-segmented measurements from three tracks. Bead, area, and surface deformation are not reproduced.
assumptions.numerics: Two finite-length locality cases, common 20 um effective dx and exact centre cell to roundoff. mesh_um request is nextafter(20,+infinity) to avoid an extra cell from floating ceil. No mesh/time convergence or 8 mm equivalence.
assumptions.locality: Compare central accepted-max liquidus W/D for two truncated tracks with source crossing at each track midpoint. Start distances are several sqrt(4*alpha_max*full_run_time) lengths, using model table diffusivity. This rationale is not a truncation-error bound; transverse, bottom, source-history and etched-operator mismatches persist.
assumptions.localLengthThreshold: Both absolute W/D differences must be at most one effective mesh h; otherwise inconclusive. Passing this sensitivity criterion establishes no equivalence to 8 mm NIST geometry.
